title: Repeated manual reactivation and resistance complaints
summary: This topic groups sparse complaints about features needing manual action on each drive and a separate report of resistance when manually operating a door, with many fragments too vague to identify the exact issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe annoyance that settings or functions must be manually disabled or redone every drive and dislike of resistance when manually operating a door.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention something happening every time or requiring manual action, but they do not provide enough context to identify the specific feature or problem.

limitations: The sample is small and many fragments are too vague to identify the underlying feature or failure mode.
The topic appears to mix at least two unrelated subjects: repeated manual setting changes and resistance in manual door operation.
